title.narrative: Contract for implementation of the main project for promoting more inclusive and accountable democratic institutions in Tanzania (known as Institutions for Inclusive Development - I4ID)

description.narrative: This activity Contract for implementation of the main project for promoting more inclusive and accountable democratic institutions in Tanzania (known as Institutions for Inclusive Development - I4ID) is a component of Promoting more inclusive and accountable democratic institutions in Tanzania reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £9,817,622. It works in the following sector(s): Legislatures and political parties, Democratic participation and civil society, Elections, Research/scientific institutions, Media and free flow of information, Human rights, Women's rights organisations and movements, and government institutions.
